status: Phase 13.3 Targeted Verification Complete — Implementation Pending

key_findings: AI image already installs 100% of Celery and task dependencies.
AI Dockerfile copies a strict superset of files compared to worker Dockerfile.
Both Dockerfiles create non-root users with identical numeric IDs (UID 1000, GID 1000).
worker/deployment.yaml wait-for-ai-migrations initContainer uses medmatch-worker:latest; updating image to medmatch-ai-service maintains full compatibility.
CI workflow .github/workflows/docker-build.yaml references worker.Dockerfile in matrix, so worker.Dockerfile should be retained as an alias or build matrix updated accordingly.

questions_verified.1_why_pytest_in_requirements: Developer convenience for initial setup; not separated in early development.

key_findings: services/ai-service/app/ contains 0 imports of pytest; pytest is only used in tests/.
CI workflow ci.yaml runs 'compileall app', not pytest, so it will continue passing without pytest.
Moving pytest and pytest-mock to requirements-dev.txt eliminates unnecessary packages from the production virtualenv with zero workflow breakage.
